title: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:12:0:00012:part:1/1
title_original: 축산자조금의 조성 및 운용에 관한 법률 시행규칙
full_text: Article 12 (Disclosure of the Acquisition and Use of the Mandatory Fund) The Management Committee shall, in accordance with Article 21(6) of the Act, publish the annual financial statements regarding the acquisition and use of the mandatory fund, and the business plan for the following fiscal year, each with the approval of the General Assembly, by March 31st of the following fiscal year and November 30th of the corresponding fiscal year, respectively. In this case, Article 6 shall be applied to the method of disclosure.
